claims.claim: Librarian and researcher skills were unavailable in this run

Flows describe behavior; named integrations confined to Scope and explicitly framed as capabilities not implementation choices.

suggestions.assertion: Checks for existing knowledge via librarian skill before starting
suggestions.reason: All three runs satisfy this via an 'Existing Knowledge' section that describes what to search rather than actually invoking the librarian skill (unavailable non-interactively). The assertion cannot distinguish a genuine librarian check from a well-worded placeholder; consider phrasing it to accept the delegation pattern explicitly or to require evidence of an actual lookup when the skill is available.

suggestions.assertion: Covers user account/onboarding capabilities for both sides
suggestions.reason: Buyer-side onboarding is implicit (handled by an assumed pre-existing account system) rather than a dedicated capability. The assertion passes on seller onboarding plus buyer library/dashboards, but does not strongly test that buyer-side onboarding is genuinely addressed.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are thorough and well-targeted for structure and coverage. The capability-count band assertion is the key discriminator across runs.
